stories.heading: A CLUB MOVING FORWARD
stories.body:
There has been a tremendous amount of change behind the scenes at Tiverton Town Football Club over the past few months, and I wanted to take this opportunity to update our supporters, sponsors, volunteers and the wider community on the exciting journey we have begun together.

Following the Club's AGM, I was honoured to accept the role of Chairman. While I knew there would be challenges ahead, I also recognised the enormous potential this football club has, both on and off the pitch. Since then, my focus has been on building a strong, hardworking team around the club that shares the same ambition – to move Tiverton Town Football Club forward in every area.

One of our first priorities was to appoint a new Board of Directors, bringing together people with different skills and experience who are passionate about the future of the club. I am delighted that Viv Curtis has continued in her invaluable role as Club Secretary, providing knowledge and continuity, while David Morgan has joined as our new Treasurer, strengthening the financial management of the club.

A significant appointment was Lee Lashenko as our new Director of Football. Lee has worked tirelessly alongside Asa, Steve and David to strengthen the first-team squad while developing a long-term football strategy that will benefit the club for many years to come.

Behind the scenes, we have continued to strengthen the club by appointing additional volunteers into key positions, including a new Under-18s Secretary, League Secretary and Welfare Officer. Every appointment plays an important role in ensuring the club is run professionally and continues to grow.

stories.heading: IMPROVING THE MATCHDAY EXPERIENCE
stories.body:
One of our biggest priorities this season has been improving the overall experience for everyone who visits the Slee Blackwell Stadium.

Our Sports Bar and Function Room have already benefited from a number of improvements, including upgraded bar facilities and an expanded range of drinks. We are delighted to now serve John Smith's, alongside Hawkstone Lager and Hawkstone Cider, while our popular Pitchside Bar has reopened on matchdays, allowing supporters to enjoy refreshments without missing any of the action.

To improve customer service, the club has invested in brand-new till systems, including handheld card payment terminals, allowing supporters to pay quickly throughout the ground. Cash payments will continue to be accepted at the turnstiles, Sports Bar and Function Room, ensuring we cater for everyone's preference.

We have also recruited additional bar staff to reduce queue times and improve service on busy matchdays, creating a more enjoyable experience for everyone attending the club.

Looking ahead, we have exciting plans for our Function Room. Working alongside Market Carpets through a fantastic sponsorship agreement, we plan to install brand-new flooring that will transform the venue and allow us to attract even more functions, private events and community activities. Becoming a financially self-sustaining football club remains one of our key objectives, and developing our hospitality facilities is an important part of achieving that vision.

stories.heading: INVESTING IN OUR FACILITIES
stories.body:
Supporters will already have noticed a great deal of activity around the stadium, with much more still to come.

We are delighted to welcome our new Head Groundsman to the club. We firmly believe that, with time and continued investment, the playing surface will become one of the best in the region. A quality pitch benefits everyone – our players, supporters and visiting clubs – and we are fully committed to supporting our Groundsman as he continues his excellent work.

Safety also remains a major priority. Over the coming months, the existing boundary wall and dugouts will be replaced with modern safety fencing, brand-new dugouts and improved pitchside facilities that will not only enhance safety but also significantly improve the appearance of the stadium from the stands.

The Tea Hut has also been improved and will now be open for both weekend and midweek fixtures, giving supporters another convenient catering option on matchdays.

We are also delighted to announce our partnership with Culmex Construction, who have generously sponsored the club by providing a brand-new Media Tower overlooking the pitch. This fantastic addition will improve media coverage while enhancing the matchday experience for supporters both inside and outside the stadium.

Further improvements around the stadium are already planned, including the reinstatement of the rear toilet facilities in time for our major events later this year.

stories.heading: FOOTBALL ACROSS THE CLUB / COMMERCIAL GROWTH
stories.body:
While much attention naturally focuses on our First Team, we are equally committed to developing football throughout every level of Tiverton Town Football Club.

We are delighted to welcome Rich, Stevie and Jack as the new management team of our Under-18s. They have already been working hard behind the scenes to prepare the squad for the season ahead, and we wish them every success as they continue developing the next generation of Tiverton Town players.

We are equally pleased that Dave Kelland continues as Manager of our Women's Team. Dave and his players continue to represent the club with pride, and we wish them every success throughout the coming season.

Our Ability Counts teams remain a hugely important part of our football family. We wish every player, coach and volunteer the very best for the new season and thank them for the incredible work they do representing Tiverton Town Football Club.

An exciting part of our long-term vision is our developing partnership with Twyford Spartans Football Club. Discussions continue to progress positively as we work towards an amalgamation that will create a genuine youth pathway into senior football at Tiverton Town.

Commercially, the club continues to move in a very positive direction. Our Commercial Manager, Craig, has worked incredibly hard alongside myself to attract new sponsors while strengthening relationships with existing partners. We are especially delighted that Slee Blackwell Solicitors have renewed their commitment for a further three years, continuing as Stadium Naming Rights Partner while also sponsoring both our Home and Away First Team shirts.
